description: This PHP source file defines a class `HomeViewAdditionaldetailsretrieve` responsible for handling AJAX requests to retrieve and display additional details for a specific module record within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for loading required metadata, retrieving the record, invoking custom functions, and formatting the response content.
